instruction: Calculate the total of all Sales values and put the result in cell E30 using a SUM formula.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to fill 'No. #' sequence numbers in the Seq No. column. Put values in wrong column (A instead of B), overwrote header row, and only completed 8 of 28 entries before time ran out.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Calc, navigate cells, select cells, type text values into cells
metadata.failure_analysis: Model selected wrong column (A instead of B for 'Seq No.'), started from row 1 instead of row 2 (overwriting header area), and could not complete the repetitive task of filling 28 cells within the time limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-cell formula task (SUM) which requires only navigating to one cell and typing one formula, well within the model's demonstrated capability of cell selection and text entry.
metadata.explanation: Task requires entering a SUM formula in E30 to total all Sales values (E2:E29). Getter reads E30 cell value with data_only=True to get computed result. Expected value is 14325.0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell E30 with data_only=True to extract the computed SUM result from the saved xlsx file.
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' expected type by directly accessing expected.get('expected_value'), with appropriate numeric tolerance (0.01).
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.

Minor coverage gap: instruction specifies 'using a SUM formula' but evaluator only checks the final numeric value, not whether a formula was actually used. An agent could type the value directly and still pass. Practically low-risk since the exact sum is unlikely to be guessed.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To fully verify the 'SUM formula' requirement, consider adding a second getter that reads E30 without data_only=True to check that the cell contains a formula (e.g., '=SUM(E2:E29)'), and add a corresponding metric to verify it.
